info.title: Company Configuration
info.description: Company configuration objects and services are for creating and managing company-wide resources such as attachments, email templates, dimensions, and users.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Dimensions
tags.description: Dimensions are a classification system used to organize, sort, and report on company information in meaningful ways. You can think of each dimension as a category with a set of values that you can apply to transactions and entries. Every transaction can be tagged with multiple dimension values to identify and report on it. For example, you can tag transactions with pre-defined locations, and then generate reports to show sales by each location.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Classes
tags.description:
[Class](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_Class_Information) is a flexible [dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Dimensions_overview_basics) that can be defined in a company and used to track just about anything. You can rename the class dimension and add custom fields if needed, and then select a class and provide values for the fields in applicable transactions. You can use the data to create custom reports that provide important business insights.

Note that renaming the class dimension in the UI does not change the name of this object in the API. You still use `class` in API requests.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Class groups
tags.description:
Classes are a dimension used to tag transaction lines for reporting, and a class group is a named set of classes used to filter or aggregate class data in financial reports.

**When to use:** Use when creating report views that group classes together by specific criteria or a curated list, or when retrieving an existing class group configuration.

**Relationships:** Contains class group members that reference individual classes. Can be associated with a specific entity.

For more information, see [Class groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=about_class_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Departments
tags.description:
Department is an optional [dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Dimensions_overview_basics) that can be used for tagging, filtering, and categorizing data in many areas of Sage Intacct.

The list of departments is shared by all entities in a company. Users can be restricted to only work with and see specific departments, which might affect what data they can see in reports, transactions, and other data records.

You can create a hierarchy of departments to reflect how departments are organized within a company. To set up a hierarchy, create the parent departments first and then specify the parent department when adding child departments.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Department groups
tags.description: A department group is a specified set of departments, or a set of departments that meet certain criteria. You can use groups to filter or display information in multiple ways, for instance by showing data from only certain departments.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Department group members
tags.description: Department group member represents a department in a department group.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employees
tags.description:
An employee in Sage Intacct represents someone who performs work for a company. They may create financial transactions such as timesheet entries or expense reports. If an employee who is also a user is entering time or expenses, they must both be associated with the same Sage Intacct contact.

For more information, read about [employees](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_te_employees) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee types
tags.description: Employee types are customizable classifications that can be defined in a company and assigned to employees to enhance reporting and insight into the value delivered by different employee categories, such as contractor, full-time, and part-time. Defining and assigning types to different employees allows you to report on and assess the value being delivered to a project, location, or other dimension on a per-employee type basis.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee rates
tags.description: Employee rates provide employee compensation details, this can be either an hourly rate or annual salary.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee groups
tags.description: Organize employees into employee groups to simplify reporting. Create employee groups that are specific to your business, then assign an employee group to each employee.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee bank file setups
tags.description:
An employee bank file setup contains the information needed to send electronic payments to a specified employee using bank files. Bank files are standard files used by banks to make multiple payments, they are generated in Sage Intacct and then uploaded to the bank's online banking portal for processing.

For more information, read [about bank files](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_payment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Earning types
tags.description: Earning types are a key component in configuring the system to post project labor costs to one or more General Ledger journals. After creating earning types, they must be assigned to employees.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Locations
tags.description:
Location is a [dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Dimensions_overview_basics) that is used to represent the geographic locations of offices or facilities, or to represent divisions in a company. Once you have defined some locations, you can set locations on transactions, and that information can be used to provide new insights in reports.
      
You can create a hierarchy of locations to reflect how locations are organized within your company.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Location groups
tags.description:
A location group is a named set of locations used to filter or aggregate location data in particular reports and graphs. For example, you can create a location group that contains all active locations or all locations with the same base currency. Location groups are a type of dimension group. 

**When to use:** Use when creating report views or financial graphs that group locations together by specific criteria or a curated list.

**Relationships:** Contains location group members that reference individual locations. Can have a primary contact and can be associated with a specific entity.

For more information, see [Location groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=about_location_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Location group members
tags.description:
A location group member represents an individual location included in a location group.

**When to use:** Use when adding or removing locations from a location group, or when retrieving the locations that belong to a specific group.

**Relationships:** Owned by a location group and linked to an individual location.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Attachments
tags.description:
An attachment object contains an array of one more files that are stored in Sage Intacct. You can attach multiple files of any type to a transaction using an attachment, such as scanned images, spreadsheets, and word-processor documents. For example, you might add ten scanned images to a single attachment for a bill. You can also add attachments to some other objects, such as customers, vendors, and employees.

It's important to note that each transaction or object can only have one attachment assigned to it. After you add an attachment, you can add or delete individual files to and from the attachment, ensuring your supporting documents are always up-to-date.

All attachments are stored in attachment [folders](company-config/folder). The folder to hold an attachment must exist before you create the attachment. You can also move an attachment to a different folder after it's created.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Files
tags.description: A digital file, such as a scanned image, spreadsheet, or word-processor document. You can attach multiple files of any type to a record or a transaction as an [attachment](company-config/attachment). Use `POST` and `PATCH` requests to the owning attachment object to create or modify a file object.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Folders
tags.description:
Folders are used to store [attachments](company-config/attachment) for easy grouping. For example, you can create an attachment folder for a project and store every supporting document for the project in that folder.

Attachment folders can be nested. The folder hierarchy can be as broad or deep as needed.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Contacts
tags.description:
Contacts serve as a common, shared address book that's used across a company by many people for a variety of purposes. Contacts hold all the information needed to contact an individual or business, including name, email address, phone number, mailing address, and more.

Contacts are almost always used with other Sage Intacct objects, such as vendors, customers, or locations. For example, you specify a contact in Order Entry and Purchasing transactions to set a ship-to, bill-to, pay-to, or return-to addresses, and to determine tax on transactions.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Contact versions
tags.description:
Contact version captures the history of changes to a [contact](company-config.contact) object. Each time a contact record is updated, the previous version is saved and the new version is added.
For AP/AR transactions, Sage Intacct stores a reference to the contact version for the bill-to, ship-to, pay-to, and return-to when the invoice is created.
If the contact changes after the invoice is created, the contact version object provides the original contact information when the invoice was created.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Document sequences
tags.description:
Use document sequencing to generate new IDs automatically for common transactions and records, such as new customers, vendors, invoices, and more. For example, you can create a document sequence for invoices. This new sequence automatically creates a new ID, such as 'INV-0100' and increments the number each time a new invoice is created.

Note: Document sequences are called "accounting sequences" in the General Ledger.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Generate next value
tags.description: Generates a new (incremented) value for a specified document sequence. When `fiscalYear` is specified, it is appended to the document sequence.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Document sequence rollovers
tags.description:
The document sequence rollover configuration holds the next number or alpha values used to generate sequences for each fiscal year. When rollover is enabled for a document sequence, a restart of the document sequence is initiated for each fiscal year.

If the configuration for a fiscal year is missing, it is automatically generated by the system when the first sequence is generated. When the system generates a configuration, the next number or alpha values from the base start values are used.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Email templates
tags.description: Use email templates to organize email content and add style to make emails stand out to customers and vendors. You can create a variety of email templates to use for different types of transactions, different vendors, or different customers. You can add merge fields to populate emails with dynamic data from Sage Intacct, such as the vendor name, contact information, and so on.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Entities
tags.description: In a multi-entity shared company, entities represent a separate tax identification or a separately secured, fully balancing set of books. Entities typically represent divisions, franchises, affiliates, associations, locations, chapters, self-balancing funds or subsidiaries, with a shared chart of accounts.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Affiliate entities
tags.description:
Affiliate entities are associated separate legal entities defined within your Sage Intacct company. Affiliate entity is a read-only standard dimension based on the list of entities in your company. You can use an affiliate entity to indicate a related entity in a transaction. Adding affiliate entities to transactions simplifies reporting for inter-entity transactions and consolidation. 

For more information, read about the [affiliate entity standard dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_affiliate_entity_dimension) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Affiliate entity groups
tags.description:
An affiliate entity group forms a collection of associated entities for reporting. For example, parent entity E100 is associated with entities E200 and E500, as a reporting group.

For more information, read about [reporting with affiliate entities](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_reporting_with_AE) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Inter-entity account mappings
tags.description:
Configure inter-entity account mapping for multi-entity shared companies to map entities to accounts which post inter-entity transactions (IETs). You can set up IET accounts for all your entities by configuring an inter-entity account mapping plan, either [basic](company-config-inter-entity-basic-map) or [advanced](company-config.inter-entity-advanced-map). The basic plan defines one common set of inter-entity accounts, while the advanced plan defines separate sets of inter-entity accounts for each entity relationship, or entity pair.

For more information, read about [inter-entity account mapping plans](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Multi-entity/Inter-entity_transactions/inter-entity-account-map-plans.htm) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Inter entity basic maps
tags.description:
Basic inter-entity account mapping enables a multi-entity company to map entities to accounts which post inter-entity transactions (IETs). It allows one common inter-entity receivable (IER) account and one inter-entity payable (IEP) account to record all IETs when there is no need to settle separate balances among the entities involved.

For more information, read about [inter-entity account mapping](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_setup_for_interentity_txns) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Inter entity advanced maps
tags.description:
Advanced inter-entity account mapping enables a multi-entity company to map pairs of transacting entities using up to four accounts to record inter-entity transactions (IETs). It allows the mapping of each entity to any combination of separate inter-entity receivable (IER) and inter-entity payable (IEP) accounts that record IETs.

For more information, read about [inter-entity account mapping](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_setup_for_interentity_txns) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Exchange rates
tags.description:
Exchange rates convert one currency to another when a company chooses not to use the Intacct Daily Rate. An exchange rate can have multiple entries (lines), each with an effective start date, a conversion rate and its reciprocal rate used when processing currency conversions in transactions.

For more information, read about [exchange rates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Exchange_rates_and_exchange_rate_types_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Exchange rate lines
tags.description:
Exchange rate lines are entries within an exchange rate object that contain details such as effective start date, exchange rate, and reciprocal rate. Each line is owned by an [exchange rate](company-config.exchange-rate) object.

For more information, read about [exchange rates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Exchange_rates_and_exchange_rate_types_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Exchange rate types
tags.description:
Exchange rate types control how currency conversions are applied in Sage Intacct, enabling foreign currency transactions to use exchange rates tailored to specific business needs. Use exchange rate types to set an alternative default rate type, create custom types or override the standard Intacct Daily Rate.

For more information, read about [exchange rate types](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_an_Exchange_Rate_Type) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Users
tags.description:
Users are individuals who have access to some part of Sage Intacct. Most users are employees, but users might also be external users who are outside of the company, such as accountants, attorneys, bankers, vendors, customers, or auditors.

Any person that wants to log in through the UI or API must have a unique user record.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_User groups
tags.description:
User groups help you manage the permissions and access of users that have the same roles or responsibilities in a company.

**When to use:** Use when you need to assign shared permissions and access to multiple users at once, or when retrieving user group configurations.

**Relationships:** Use the user group member object to add and delete users from user groups.

**Lifecycle context:** After you add a user to a user group, they automatically inherit all permissions and access defined by the roles assigned to that user group. 

For more information, see [User groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_user_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center. In the case of users assigned to multiple user groups, the access privileges closest to the user prevail. For more information, see [Access privileges for users in multiple groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Access_Privileges_In_Multiple_Groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_User group members
tags.description:
A user group member represents a user assigned to a user group.

**When to use:** Use when assigning users to a group to manage shared permissions and access, or when retrieving the members of a specific user group.

**Relationships:** Linked to a user and a user group.

For more information, see [User groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_user_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Roles
tags.description:
Roles are used in companies that have role-based permissions. Companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

A role is basically a group of permissions. Roles save time and make it easier to assign the same set of permissions to multiple users and to ensure that permissions are consistent across users. Permissions to perform certain tasks are assigned to specific roles, and roles can then be assigned to users or user groups. You use [role-permission-assignment objects](company-config/role-permission-assignment) to assign permissions to roles.

You can define roles for various job functions. For example, you can assign all Accounts Receivable clerks the same role instead of assigning permissions to each of them individually. Or when an employee leaves the company, you can assign their role to their replacement. This ensures that the new employee has the same permissions.

You can assign more than one role to a user. The user will then have all permissions for each role. For example, you assign Role A and Role B to a user. Role A has permissions that Role B does not. The user has all permissions in Role A plus the ones in Role B. A user can be individually assigned roles and also be part of a group that has a role. The user gets the total permissions from all assigned roles.

If a company uses role-based permissions, you must assign each user to a role or to a user group that's assigned to a role. If a user does not have an associated role, they will not be able to access applications and features.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Role user maps
tags.description:
A role user map associates a role with a user. It is an owned object of a [role object](company-config.role). A role-user-map object is created automatically when a role is assigned to a user in the `roles` array of a `user` object. When the array of roles is updated, all role user maps for that user are deleted and new role user maps are created for the updated roles.

Roles are used in companies that have role-based permissions. Companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Role user group maps
tags.description:
A role user group map associates a role with a user group. It is an owned object of a [role object](company-config.role). A role-user-group-map object is created automatically when a role is assigned to a user group in the `roles` array of a `user-group` object. When the array of roles is updated, all role user group maps for that user group are deleted and new role user group maps are created for the updated roles.

Roles are used in companies that have role-based permissions. Companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Permissions
tags.description:
Permissions enable users to perform a particular function or task within a specific area of Sage Intacct. For example, a user might have permission within the General Ledger to view financial reports but not to create, edit, or delete them. 

A permission specifies a module, such as `accountsPayable`, a specific permission name, such as `vendors`, and the allowed access rights for that permission, such as `list`, `view`, `add`, and `edit`.

You use [role-permission-assignment objects](company-config/role-permission-assignment) to assign permissions to roles.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Role permission assignments
tags.description:
A role permission assignment shows a single permission and set of access rights for a role. It is an owned object of a [role object](company-config.role). You create, update, and delete role permission assignment objects through the `rolePermissionAssignments` array in the owning role object.

Roles are used in companies that have role-based permissions. Companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Audit histories
tags.description: Audit history provides detailed information about field-level modifications made to particular object.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Advanced audit histories
tags.description: Advanced audit history provides detailed information about access to personal data stored in contact, customer, and vendor objects for compliance with data protection laws, such as HIPAA.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Cloud storage
tags.description: Use cloud storage to define targets for delivery of report output. See [Cloud Storage for reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Setting_up_cloud_storage) in the Sage Intacct Help Center for details.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Company messages
tags.description: Use company messages to share short announcement or reminders with users. For example, remind employees to submit weekly timesheets or announce an upcoming company holiday.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Cover letter templates
tags.description:
A cover letter template is a document you can include in a group of reports. 
When you send the group of reports, use the cover letter to introduce the reports and describe what information they contain.
In Intacct, you can create a cover letter and include it in a memorized report group.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Email delivery records
tags.description: The delivery record for the email delivery service lets you check if any sent email encountered errors. See [Enhanced email delivery log](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Enhanced_email_delivery_log) topic in the Sage Intacct Help Center for more information.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_External authorizations
tags.description: Use an external authorization record to allow another Sage Intacct company to access your company externally for a specified time period or until you disable the access.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Holidays
tags.description: Specifies a holiday established for a company and the schedule to which that holiday belongs.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Holiday schedules
tags.description:
A holiday schedule consists of a related group of individual holidays. 
By creating a holiday schedule, you can configure the system to automatically reject timesheets with time worked on a designated holiday or apply a different pay scale for hourly workers who are allowed to work on holidays.
For more information, see [Holiday schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_a_Schedule_of_Company_Holidays) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Payment provider notifications
tags.description: A payment provider notification refers to a notification that Intacct receives and subsequently processes to update an object, depending on the notification type.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Sandboxes
tags.description:
A sandbox is a copy of your production environment that you can use for testing or training without affecting your production data or configuration.

**When to use:** Use when you need an isolated environment to safely develop, test, or validate integrations, configurations, or workflows before deploying changes to production.

**Relationships:** Linked to the company configuration. You can use the [refresh](company-config.company-config.sandbox-refresh) workflow, which updates the sandbox to reflect your latest production environment changes.

**Lifecycle context:** Sandboxes last for the duration of the billing cycle and can be refreshed up to four times annually. When you submit a sandbox creation request, the sandbox state is first `pending`. During the creation process, the sandbox state changes to `inProgress`. Should sandbox creation fail, the state changes to `failed`. After a sandbox is successfully created, its state changes from `inProgress` to `ready`. At this point you can log in to it from the Sandboxes page, update the sandbox, get its details, refresh it, or delete it. For more information, see [Sandboxes](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_sandboxes) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Transaction currencies
tags.description:
The transaction currency object defines the currencies that can be used in company transactions where multiple transaction currencies are enabled. A transaction currency can be either an ISO currency or a custom currency. Sage Intacct provides a list of ISO currencies with predefined properties, and you can create custom currencies with user-defined properties.

For more information, read about [transaction currencies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Viewing_and_Managing_the_Transaction_Currency_List) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Company preferences
tags.description: Use the company preference object to manage company-wide settings and preferences. See [Company information](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Company_information) in the Intacct Help Center for more information.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Multi-entity preferences
tags.description:
Configure preferences for multi-entity companies. In a multi-entity shared company, entities represent a separate tax identification or a separately secured, fully balancing set of books. Entities typically represent divisions, franchises, affiliates, associations, locations, chapters, self-balancing funds, or subsidiaries, with a shared chart of accounts.

For more information, read about [multi-entity companies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_learn_about_me) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Consolidation preferences
tags.description:
Configure preferences for consolidations in Sage Intacct, including domestic, global, and advanced ownership consolidation. Each consolidation subscription enables you to consolidate books in a multi-entity shared company. You can select a relevant consolidation subscription based on your business needs.

For more information, read about [consolidation subscriptions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Comparison_consolidation_options) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Advanced consolidation preferences
tags.description:
Configure preferences for advanced ownership consolidations. Advanced ownership consolidation uses ownership structures to enable multi-level consolidations and automated non-controlling interest entries in a multi-entity company.

For more information, read about [advanced consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_TOC_advanced_ownership_consolidations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Order Entry preferences
tags.description: Use the Order Entry preference object to manage settings and preferences for the Order Entry application. See [Configure Order Entry](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Configuring_the_Order_Entry_Application) in the Sage Intacct Help Center for details.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Purchasing preferences
tags.description: Use the Purchasing preference object to manage settings and preferences for the Purchasing application. See [Configure the Purchasing application](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Configuring_Purchase_Orders) in the Sage Intacct Help Center for details.

get.description: Lists all standard and user-defined dimensions in a company along with integration information about each one.

Returns up to 100 object references from the collection with a key, ID, and link for each object. This operation is mostly for use in testing; use the [query service](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/tags/common_resources_query) to find objects that meet certain criteria and specify the properties that are returned.

post.description: Creates a new class. You can think of this as adding a new value to the dimension that you can use to tag transactions for reporting.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: System-assigned key for the class.

get.description: Returns detailed information for a specified class.

patch.description: Updates an existing class by setting field values. Any fields not provided remain unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes a class. You can delete a class if it is not being used or referenced. Deleted classes cannot be recovered.

get.description: Returns a collection with a key, ID, and link for each class group. This operation is mostly for use in testing; use the [query service](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/tags/common_resources_query) to find objects that meet certain criteria and to specify properties that are returned.

post.description: Creates a new class group. You can create a class group of type `all` or `specific`. If you create a class group of type `all`, you must provide a `memberFilter` to select the classes to include in the group. If you create a class group of type `specific`, you must provide a list of classes in the `groupMembers` array. You can optionally filter the array with the `memberFilter` settings.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: System-assigned unique key for the class group.

get.summary: Get the details of a class group
get.description: Returns detailed information for a specified class group.

patch.description: Updates an existing class group by setting field values. Any fields not provided remain unchanged.

get.description: Returns up to 100 department references from the collection with a key, ID, and link for each department. This operation is mostly for use in testing; use the [query service](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/tags/common_resources_query) to find departments that meet certain criteria and to specify the properties that are returned.

post.description: Creates a new department.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: System-assigned key for the department.

get.description: Returns detailed information for a specified department.

patch.description: Updates an existing department by setting field values. Any fields not provided remain unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes a department. You can delete a department if it is not being used or referenced. Deleted departments cannot be recovered.

get.description: Returns up to 100 department groups from the collection with a key, ID, and link for each group. This operation is mostly for use in testing; use the [query service](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/tags/common_resources_query) to find department groups that meet certain criteria and specify the properties that are returned.

post.description: Creates a new department group.

parameters.name: key

objects.company-config.multi-entity-pref.description: Configure preferences for consolidations in Sage Intacct for multi-entity companies.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the multi-entity preferences.

enableMultipleBaseCurrency.description:
Indicates whether multiple base currencies are enabled for entities within the company. When set to `true`, you can set up a separate base currency, or operating and reporting currency, for each entity in your company. When `false`, all entities in the company share the same base currency. Applies when multi-currency management is enabled in the General Ledger.

For more information, read about [enabling multiple base currencies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Enable_multi_base_currency) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

approvalCurrency.description: Specifies the approval currency used to evaluate transaction approval thresholds for purchase transactions and expense reports.

isForm1099.description:
Indicates whether 1099 forms are issued using entity-level information instead of top-level company information. When `true` Sage Intacct prints the 1099 forms using the legal and tax details defined for each entity.

For more information, read about [printing 1099 forms for multi-entity companies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=ME_company_and_1099s) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

disableEntitySlideIn.description: Indicates whether access is restricted to the top-level company only. When `true`, users can only access the top-level company and cannot access or navigate to individual entities. Applies only to multi-entity companies with a single base currency.

restrictSubledgerTxnToEntity.description: Indicates whether to restrict subledger transactions to the entity level only. When `true`, users can only enter subledger transactions at the entity level.

restrictGLTxnToEntity.description: Indicates whether to restrict General Ledger transactions to the entity level only. When `true`, users can only enter General Ledger transactions at the entity level.

enableCustomerRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments are available to each top-level customer. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each top-level customer.

enableVendorRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments are available to each top-level vendor. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each top-level vendor.

enableCheckingAccountRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments can work with each checking account. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each checking account.

enableSavingsAccountRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments can work with each savings account. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each savings account.

enableAffiliateEntity.description:
Indicates whether to use the affiliate entity dimension in the company. When set to `true`, you can use the affiliate entity dimension for inter-entity transactions and reporting.

For more information, read about [the affiliate entity standard dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_affiliate_entity_dimension) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

interEntityAccountMappingPlan.description:
Specifies the type of inter-entity account mapping:
* `basic`: Use only one set of inter-entity accounts per entity.
* `advanced`: Define separate sets of inter-entity accounts for each entity relationship, or entity pair.

limitAPCredit.description: Indicates whether to limit Accounts Payable (AP) credits to the owning entity.When set to `true`, credits are applied only to bills owned by the same entity as the credit. When `false`, credits are applied to bills owned by the same entity first, and then to bills owned by other entities, starting with the oldest bill.

limitARCredit.description: Indicates whether to limit Accounts Receivable (AR) credits to the owning entity. When set to `true`, credits are applied only to invoices owned by the same entity as the credit. When `false`, credits are applied to invoices owned by the same entity first, and then to invoices owned by other entities, starting with the oldest invoice.

isModuleConfigured.description: Indicates whether the multi-entity module has been configured for use in the company.

interEntityTxns.description: Use these settings to control how Sage Intacct records transactions that involve two or more entities.

enableForJournalEntry.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-entity transactions for journal entries. When set to `true`, Sage Intacct automatically creates offsetting entries for journal entries that involve two or more entities. When `false`, all balancing line items must be entered manually.

manuallyBalanceSubledgerTxns.description:
Indicates whether to disable automatic tracking of Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) inter-entity subledger transactions. 

When set to `true`, inter-entity AP and AR subledger transactions must be balanced manually, you do not need to specify a `creditsJournal`. When `false`, Sage Intacct automatically creates offsetting journal entries to track inter-entity AP and AR subledger transactions.

manuallyBalanceSubledgerCredits.description:
Indicates whether to disable automatic recording of Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) inter-entity credits, adjustments, and advances.

When set to `true`, inter-entity AP and AR credits must be balanced manually, you do not need to specify a `creditsJournal`. When `false`, Sage Intacct automatically creates offsetting journal entries to track inter-entity AP and AR credits, adjustments, and advances.

creditsJournal.description: Specifies the journal to use when posting inter-entity credit bills or invoices to AP or AR, respectively. This journal is used when credits are applied to AR invoices or AP bills that generate an inter-entity transaction (IET) with no source payment record.

key.description: Unique key for the credits journal.

href.description: URL endpoint for the credits journal.

balanceJournalEntryBy.description: Indicates whether to enforce journal entry balancing by location or entity. If you choose not to enable inter-entity transactions, you can enforce journal entry balancing by location instead of entity.

* `advancedOwnershipConsolidation` - Advanced consolidation features including multi-tier consolidations and complex ownership structures.

For more information, read about [consolidation subscriptions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Comparison_consolidation_options) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

enableForeignCurrency.description: For multi-currency companies, set to `true` to use multiple currencies in your Order Entry transactions.

enableFuturePostingRestriction.description: Set to `true` to inherit the thresholds that are configured for the General Ledger and Accounts Payable for handling transactions that have a future GL posting date.

enableDraftMode.description: Set to `true` to allow saving transactions as a draft to finish and post later. This setting does not apply to recurring transactions.

omitMarkDraftPrintedTxn.description: When `true`, draft transactions are not flagged as printed after any print or email option is used.

displayPaymentStatus.description: When `true`, allows access to payment details for Order Entry transactions directly. Applies only to transactions that post to Accounts Payable.

enableAdvanceTxnProcessing.description:
Advanced transaction processing provides access to the following features for Order Entry transactions: 
- Convert two or more transactions into one transaction  
- Convert line items from different transactions into one transaction
- Process two or more transactions at a time

enableBillToContactAtLine.description: When `true`, you can add a bill-to contact on contract invoice line items. Applicable to Contracts data only.

enableShipToContactAtLine.description:
When `true`, you can add a ship-to contact on a transaction line item to: 
  - Calculate tax at the line level based on the ship-to contact. Taxes are always calculated at the line level based on a ship-to contact. 
    However, you can change the ship-to contact at the line level, depending on the transaction definition configuration. 
  - Specify multiple ship-to addresses on a single sales transaction for use when printing sales documents.
A ship-to contact at the line level for tax calculation is only applicable to Avalara and Advanced Tax users.

enableInterEntityCOGSPostings.description:
For sales transactions that use inventory from another entity, set to `true` to ensure that the value of the sold inventory is properly recorded in the General Ledger. 
Journal entries for inter-entity receivables and payables are automatically created for the COGS (cost of goods sold) when the sales transaction is posted.

useLineItemDimensionsInSubtotal.description:
For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment only. Set to `true` to have the dimension values that are enabled for line items used as the dimension values in the subtotal lines.
If `editDimensionInSubtotal` is also `true`, the dimension values from the line items override any dimension values that are enabled for the lines in the subtotals.

editDimensionInSubtotal.description:
For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment only. Set to `true` to specify dimension values in the subtotal lines for transactions.
If `useLineItemDimensionsInSubtotal` is also `true`, the dimension values from the line items override any dimension values that are enabled for the lines in the subtotals.

editLocationDepartmentInSubtotal.description: When `editDimensionInSubtotal` is `true`, set this field to `true` at the top level in a multi-entity company, to enable selecting values for location and department in subtotal lines.

distributeDimensions.description:
Applicable only for multi-entity companies and entity level users. Set to `true` to distribute dimensions across subtotal lines, including proportional distributions.
For custom reports for subtotal details, the subtotal information for the entity-level transactions is included.

enablePriceConversion.description: Set to `true` to select price instead of quantity (default) as a conversion option for non-inventory line items on orders and invoices.

overrideDefaultTxnConversionType.description: For non-inventory items, set to `true` to allow to change the default conversion type to price on orders and invoices.

constructionPreferences.description: Preferences applicable for construction enabled companies.

prefillConversionZero.description: Set to `true` if you want a 0 (zero) to prefill on lines price or quantity (depending on conversion type) when converting a document, rather than converting the remaining amount.

includeFullyConvertedLines.description: Set to `true` to include fully converted lines during conversion.

enableReverseConversions.description: Set to `true` to enable reverse conversions.

senderEmailProfile.description:
Specifies the source for adding contact details to emails with attached transactions (name, email address, and phone number).
- `userProfile` - Use the sender email details from user profile, if it exists, else use the company email.
- `contactProfile` - Use the sender email details from the company profile.

contactsInTxn.description:
Determines whether to include all contacts or only contacts related to customer in transaction for pay-to, return-to, or deliver-to contacts.
- `all` - Include all contacts in transaction dropdown lists.
- `vendorContacts` - Restrict the contacts that are included in transaction dropdown lists to the contacts that are associated with the selected customer.

taxPreferences.description: Tax preferences for Order Entry transactions.

enableAdvancedTax.description:
Enable Advanced Tax as the tax calculation method for Order Entry transactions:





  - Set to `true` if your company is not subscribed to the Taxes application. This option enables Advanced Tax for the tax calculation method. You create tax details, tax schedules, and tax schedule maps to define the tax mapping that Sage Intacct uses to calculate taxes in transactions.
  - Set to `false` if you've enabled Avalara AvaTax for your application or plan to use Simple Tax. Advanced Tax is not compatible with using either of these two other tax calculation methods.
  - This field is set to `true` and cannot be changed if you're subscribed to the Taxes application. You can create an Advanced Tax solution and assign the tax solution to the applicable entities.

enableSubtotalTemplates.description: Set to `true` to use templates to populate the subtotals in transaction definitions. You can configure different entities to use different subtotals.

overrideTaxScheduleOnLine.description: Set to `true` to override tax entry level for sale orders.

priceAndDiscountPreferences.description: Price and discount preferences for Order Entry transactions.

enableSuggestedPriceDiscount.description: Set to `true` to enable adding a discount percent to line items on Order Entry transactions to add custom discounts.

enablePriceSchedule.description: Set to `true` to enable price schedule for Order Entry transactions. You can then apply any price schedule associated with a customer to order entry for that customer.

enableCustomerPriceLists.description: Set to `true` to enable customer price lists for Order Entry transactions. You can then assign price lists to specific customers. If you assign a price list to a customer, the price list overrides the one associated with the transaction definition for the Order Entry transaction.

enableFixedCustomerDiscount.description: Set to `true` to enable fixed customer discount for Order Entry transactions. You can then apply the fixed or blanket discount percentage for a customer to Order Entry for that customer.

itemPrecision.description: Determines the number of decimal places used for unit price and cost.

enableStartAndEndDate.description:
Set to `true` if you have items that are contracts or subscriptions. When you enable this option, Intacct adds a Contract tab to the Item Information page so that you can define the contract period for an item.
When this option is enabled, you can:





  - Define the contract period for an item. For example, you might have a subscription item that has a 12-month period.
  - Add the item to an order, along with the actual start and end date.

enableKit.description: Set to `true` to enable grouping a set of individual components, which you build and invoice as a single item. For example, you can build a group of computer components into a computer that you sell and invoice as a single item.

preventNegativeInventory.description:
Determines whether you can save Order Entry or Inventory Control transactions that create negative inventory for items:
- Set to `true` to prevent saving transactions that would cause the quantity on hand to become negative at all warehouses. Sage Intacct issues a warning message instead.
- Set to `false` to permit transactions which cause the quantity on hand to become negative.

disableQuantityChange.description: Set to `true` to prevent users from making certain changes during the workflow, such as editing a line item to increase the quantity or adding new line items. When `true`, users can still decrease quantities and delete line items.

enableAdvanceWorkflow.description: Set to `true` to enable advanced workflow for order entry transactions. When `true`, users can set up different transaction definitions for different types of order entry transactions.

doNotValidateLinesBeforeDeleting.description: Set to `false` to validate whether a line reference exists between change order documents. A line reference between change orders determines the order in which you can delete change orders.

href.description: URL endpoint for the Order Entry preference.

enableDropShip.description: If your company is subscribed to Order Entry and Purchasing, set to `true` to enable a drop-ship workflow that allows the system to automatically create Purchasing transactions for sales transaction line items that are selected for drop ship.

dropShipLines.description: Details of the drop ship preference.

enableBuyToOrder.description: If your company is subscribed to Order Entry and Purchasing, set to `true` to enable a buy-to-order workflow that allows the system to automatically create Purchasing transactions for sales transaction line items that are selected for buy to order.

buyToOrderLines.description: Details of the buy to order preference.

documentConfigurationLines.description: Details of the document configuration preference.

- When `false`, employee users can access all Purchasing transactions that have a template type set to `quote`.

enableAdvanceTxnProcessing.description:

- Convert two or more transactions into one transaction  
- Convert line items from different transactions into one transaction
- Process two or more transactions at a time

deliverToContactPreferences.description:
Use to add a deliver-to contact to Purchasing transactions to:
- Calculate tax using the contact that corresponds to where your company will take possession of products or services and optionally calculate line-level tax subtotals for different deliver-to contacts. Only applicable to Avalara and Advanced Tax.
- Specify multiple delivery addresses on a single Purchasing transaction for use when printing Purchasing documents.

deliverToHeaderLevelContact.description: When `true`, users can set default deliver-to contact at the header level of the Purchasing transaction.

deliverToContact.description: When `deliverToHeaderLevelContact` is `true`, specifies the deliver-to contact for the Purchasing transactions.

deliverToLineLevelContact.description: Set to `true` to allow different deliver-to contacts for the line items in a Purchasing transaction. Enabling line-level deliver-to contacts also enables line-level subtotals.

postAdditionsInTxnCurrency.description:
For multi-currency companies, enables additional postings to be posted in the transaction currency and not the base currency.
Posting in the transaction currency ensures that journal entries are consistently recorded for all posted transactions in compliance with the rules for multi-currency transaction posting. The transaction currency is converted to the base currency using the exchange rate in effect at the time transactions are posted.

enableMatchTolerances.description:
Set to `true` to enable match tolerances, which validate the percent tolerance for quantity and unit price when converting a source transaction to the transaction to validate. Sage Intacct flags the lines in the transaction as an exception, when either the quantity, unit price, or both is higher or lower than the percent tolerance.
Manage transaction definitions that you want to validate and the percent tolerance for quantity and unit price using the 'purchasing/match-tolerance-setup' object.

matchTolerancesGLAccount.description:
Match tolerance GL account. When `enableMatchTolerances` is set to `true`, the variance posts to this account.
When `null`, the variance posts according to the account mapping in the transaction definition.

editDimensionInSubtotal.description:
For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment only. Set to `true` to specify dimension values in the subtotal lines for transactions.

enablePriceConversion.description: Set to `true` to choose price instead of quantity (default) as a conversion option for non-inventory line items on orders and invoices.

overrideDefaultTxnConversionType.description: For non-inventory items, set to `true` to change the default conversion type to price on orders and invoices.

enableMultipleDocumentConversion.description: Set to `true` to convert multiple documents, including lines of documents, into a single Purchasing transaction so that you can pay a vendor in one payment.

constructionPreferences.description: Construction preferences, for Construction enabled companies.

prefillConversionZero.description: Set to `true` to prefill conversion price or quantity (depending on conversion type) with 0 (zero).

includeFullyConvertedLines.description: Set to `true` to include fully converted lines during conversion.

enableReverseConversions.description: Set to `true` to enable reverse conversions.

senderEmailProfile.description: The source for contact details in emails with attached transactions (name, email address, and phone number).

contactsInTxn.description: Indicates whether to include all contacts or restrict to contacts related to a specified vendor, in transaction for pay-to, return-to, or deliver-to contacts.

enableAdvancedTax.description:
Set to `true` to use Advanced Tax as the tax calculation method. Create tax details, schedules, and tax schedule maps to define the tax mapping for the tax calculations in transactions. Set to `true` by default when subscribed to the Taxes application and cannot modified.

Set to `false` if you've enabled Avalara AvaTax or plan to use Simple Tax. Advanced Tax is not compatible with using either of these two other tax calculation methods.

enableSubtotalTemplates.description:
Set to `true` to use templates to populate the subtotals in transaction definitions. You can configure transaction definitions to use different subtotals for different entities.
Transactions created from an entity will use the subtotals from the subtotal template associated with the entity.

overrideTaxScheduleOnLine.description: Set to `true` to override the tax entry level for purchase orders.

priceAndDiscountPreferences.description: Price and discount preferences for Purchasing transactions.

enablePriceSchedule.description: Set to `true` to apply any price schedule associated with a vendor to purchasing for that vendor.

enableVendorPriceLists.description: Enable vendor price lists for Purchasing transactions. This enables you to assign price lists to specific vendors. If you assign a price list to a vendor, this price list overrides the one associated with the transaction definition for the Purchasing transaction.

enableFixedVendorDiscount.description: Set to `true` to apply the fixed or blanket discount percentage for a vendor to purchasing for that vendor.

itemPrecision.description: The default is 2 decimal places for unit price and cost. Depending on your required level of precision, you can set as many as 10 decimal places.

disableQuantityChange.description: Set to `true` to prevent certain changes during the workflow, such as modifying a line item to increase the quantity or adding new line items. You can still decrease quantities and delete line items.

priceVarianceGLPostingPreferences.description: Price variance GL posting preferences for Purchasing transaction.

automatePriceVariancePosting.description: Set to `true` to have the variance between the standard cost and the actual purchase or invoice price automatically posted.

purchasePriceVarianceGLAccount.description: Price variance GL account for Purchasing transactions.

enablePurchasingApproval.description: Set to `true` to enable approval workflow for Purchasing transactions. Manage approval policies and rules via the `purchasing/approval-policy` object.

requireVendorForApproval.description: Set to `true` to require a vendor to be specified on the transaction before being sent for approval. After a vendor is specified for the transaction, the vendor cannot be changed.

requireReapproval.description:
Specify the conditions under which a transaction requires reapproval.
- `noReapproval` - The transaction does not require reapproval.
- `whenLineAmountChange` - The transaction requires reapproval only if the line amount changes.
- `anyLineOrSubtotalAmountChange` - The transaction requires reapproval if any line or subtotal amount changes.

enableEmailNotifications.description: Set to `true` to enable email notifications for Purchasing approval transactions.

enableDelegation.description: Set to `true` to enable delegation for Purchasing approval, so that an admin user can delegate their approval tasks to another user.

adminApprover.description: An admin user who can terminate the rest of the approval cycle for a transaction by approving or declining the transaction.

enableAdvanceWorkflow.description: Set to `true` to enable advanced workflows for Purchasing transactions. Turning on advanced workflows cannot be reversed. If you enable advanced workflows in one application, it is automatically enabled for Order Entry, Purchasing, and Inventory Control.

automationPreferences.description:
With AP Automation with Purchasing, you define which Purchasing transactions you want to automate. You can automate transactions with document matching, without document matching, or both.
Then, instead of manually adding and converting Purchasing documents to vendor invoices, you let Sage Intacct create incoming transactions using email or upload vendor invoice documents for automated processing.

enableAutomationWithDocumentMatching.description: Set to `true` to automate transactions with document matching. Manage the transaction definition mapping via the 'purchasing/txn-automation-preference' object.

enableLineLevelPOMatching.description: Set to `true` to enable line level matching for Purchasing automation. When enabled, automation matches with line items from the document.

enableAutomationNoDocumentMatching.description: Set to `true` to enable standalone purchase order matching for Purchasing automation. Manage transaction definition mapping via the 'purchasing/txn-automation-without-match-preference' object.

enableForm1099.description: By default, transaction line items for a 1099 vendor are flagged for 1099 treatment. Set this field to `true` to let users manage individual line items, which exclude them from a 1099 form for a 1099 vendor.

enableOverrideForm1099.description: By default, all transaction line items for a vendor are associated with a specific 1099 form and box. Set this field to `true` to override the default for an individual line item within a transaction.

doNotValidateLinesBeforeDeleting.description: Set to `true` to validate whether a line reference exists between change order documents. A line reference between change orders determines the order in which you can delete change orders.

objects.purchasing.txn-match-tolerance-p.description: With match tolerances, Sage Intacct automatically compares the quantities and unit prices when you convert from one Purchasing transaction to the next. If the quantity or unit price in any line item is not within the tolerance range you set, Sage Intacct flags the draft or converted transaction with an exception.

key.description: System-assigned key for the transaction match tolerance preference.

id.description: System-assigned ID for the transaction match tolerance preference.

txnDefinitionToValidate.description:
Specifies a transaction definition to validate. When a source transaction is converted to a new transaction with this transaction definition, the new transaction is flagged as an exception if either, or both, of the following are true: 
- The quantity for a line varies from the quantity in the converted-from transaction by more than the percent specified in the `quantityTolerance` field - if either under or over.
- The unit price for a line varies from the unit price in the converted-from transaction by more than the percent specified in the `priceTolerance` field - if either under or over.

key.description: Unique key for the transaction definition.

id.description: Unique ID for the transaction definition.

name.description: Unique name for the transaction definition.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction definition.

quantityTolerance.description: The percent variance in quantity (over or under) that triggers the converted-to transaction to be flagged with an exception. The variance is calculated based on the difference in quantity in the source transaction and the transaction being converted to.

priceTolerance.description: The percent variance in unit price (over or under) that triggers the converted-to transaction to be flagged with an exception. The variance is calculated based on the difference in unit price in the source transaction and the transaction being converted to.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction match tolerance preference.
